description:
Get observations for a FRED series.
Popular: GDP, UNRATE, CPIAUCSL, FEDFUNDS, DGS10, MORTGAGE30US
units transforms the values server-side, e.g. pc1 = % change from a year ago (CPI inflation), pch = % change from the previous period.

aggregation_method.description: With frequency: avg (default), sum, or eop (end of period)

frequency.description: d=daily, w=weekly, bw=biweekly, m=monthly, q=quarterly, sa=semiannual, a=annual

units.description: lin=levels (default), chg=change, ch1=change from a year ago, pch=% change, pc1=% change from a year ago, pca=compounded annual rate of change, cch=continuously compounded rate of change, cca=continuously compounded annual rate, log=natural log

name: fred_series_data
